categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Goaland Energy Conservation Tech. Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, design, production, and sales of pure water cooling equipment for high-power density electrical devices. Its main product lines include pure water cooling systems for DC transmission valves, new energy power converters, flexible AC transmission thyristor valves, high-power electrical drive frequency converters, data center liquid cooling products, and energy storage liquid cooling products. The company also provides engineering operation and maintenance services related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in pure water cooling technology using high insulation and high specific heat capacity pure water as the main cooling medium in a closed-loop forced circulation system. It employs customized and modular product structures, advanced manufacturing processes such as ultrasonic cleaning of stainless steel pipes, salt fog resistance, thermal bending of water pipes, and injection molding of PVDF components. The company also develops proprietary control system software tailored to the specific cooling equipment, ensuring high reliability and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned enterprises and listed companies in the power industry, such as State Grid, China Southern Power Grid, and major equipment manufacturers like Xi'an XD, ABB, Siemens, and others. The company serves industries related to DC transmission, new energy power generation (wind and solar), flexible AC transmission, high-power electrical drives, data centers, energy storage, petrochemical, rail transit, military ships, medical equipment, and steel and chemical sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 90% of revenue. It has established subsidiaries and operations in multiple Chinese cities including Guangzhou, Yueyang, and Shanghai, and also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in the United States providing after-sales services. The company is expanding its international market presence alongside domestic growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangzhou Goaland operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of specialized pure water cooling equipment and related control systems. It procures raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and delivers customized cooling solutions directly to downstream power equipment manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous innovation in full-scenario thermal management technologies and industrialization, emphasizing R&D in power electronics thermal management, energy storage thermal management, ICT thermal management, and special industry thermal management. It invests in developing new products for data centers, energy storage, and flexible transmission systems, and pursues international talent acquisition and brand building. Key R&D projects include development of high and low-temperature energy storage labs, advanced cooling components, intelligent diagnostic systems, and modular liquid cooling solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized and standardized pure water cooling equipment and related control systems. The company also earns income from engineering operation and maintenance services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales with long-term technical cooperation and brand demonstration strategies to secure large-scale projects and maintain customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically in the pure water cooling equipment industry, with technology and product lines at or above national advanced levels and some reaching international advanced standards. It competes with global giants like ABB and Siemens, but domestic firms have increasingly gained market share due to localization and strong service capabilities. The industry is characterized by high concentration and significant entry barriers due to technical complexity and reliability requirements.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 573 million, a decline of nearly 70% compared to the previous year, primarily due to the divestment of a subsidiary. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 31.8 million, reflecting a loss year. Despite the downturn, the company’s adjusted net profit excluding non-recurring items improved by nearly 40%. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 1.82 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.4 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangzhou Goaland emphasizes its proprietary pure water cooling technology that significantly enhances the efficiency, reliability, and lifespan of high-power electrical devices by providing high heat transfer efficiency and environmental friendliness. Its products feature customized and modular designs tailored to diverse application scenarios, supported by advanced manufacturing processes and integrated control systems. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and comprehensive service system provide competitive differentiation and customer trust in critical power and data center applications.
